method: Built-in image_gen; one transparent 3D portrait per character, encoded to WebP quality 86 with alpha preserved.
identityReferences: Original portraits under public/mascots/. The user-supplied Charlie Munger image is the target 3D style reference. Approved 3D Socrates is the collection style anchor for the remaining seven.

subjects.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a premium square 3D-rendered character portrait, transparent PNG, for the Neuroplastic intellectual reading app. Image 1 is the existing character identity, clothing, expression and prop reference. Image 2 is the user's Charlie Munger portrait and is the TARGET 3D RENDERING STYLE ONLY: use its sculpted facial volume, beautiful soft studio lighting, believable eyes, dimensional hair, tactile fabric and mature animated-film charm. Preserve the character in image 1; do not turn him into Charlie Munger. Create an exceptionally polished, appealing, stylized semi-realistic 3D bust with warm personality, expressive brows and a subtle smile. Smooth carefully sculpted forms, gentle skin subsurface scattering, soft key light from upper left, restrained warm rim light, realistic shaded folds and softly modeled hair. Clear three-quarter upper-torso silhouette, head approximately 50 percent of the canvas, all important hair, face, hands and prop visible with 8 percent transparent margin. Strong readability at 64 pixels. No outlines, pencil texture, drawing, flat vector shapes, flat painting, text, labels, signature, watermark, logo, medallion, frame, background scene, floor, or cast shadow outside the character. Actually transparent background, not a painted checkerboard. Elegant original museum-quality educational mascot, approachable and intelligent, no plastic toy shine, no grotesque caricature, no giant baby eyes. Use the same studio setup, camera height and material finish as a unified eight-character collection.
SOCRATES: keep the bald forehead, unruly silver side curls and flowing curly silver beard, broad snub nose and warmly inquisitive face from image 1. One brow raised; a knowing friendly smile. Ivory Greek robe with a dusty lavender drape. One hand thoughtfully touches his beard, the other raises one index finger. Remove the floating question-mark symbol entirely. Keep his personality curious and slightly amused. His lovely soft 3D beard and thoughtfully lit face are the focal point.
